dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: Cooler Master publishes the same page's Length as 100mm, which fixes the first figure; the remaining two are the SFX unit's standard width and height, recorded as thicknessMm 125 and heightMm 63.5. Length is the figure case vendors constrain, and it is the one quoted rather than inferred.

notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped; all from source.cat6.cooler-master.v550-sfx-gold.product.
